description:
Sol Renewed

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
- Adds Sol: the eight planets, Pluto, and the moons that matter, sized and spaced so you can actually fly across it.

Sol is not on the map when you start a game. There is a quest to go and find it, and drag it into the Persean Sector.
Colonize it and the Sector remembers what Sol used to be, and comes to take it off you.
No radiation mechanic. Nothing here is a survey-and-forget rock.

Requires LunaLib and LazyLib.

Screenshots

The Quest: "Transferring Sol"
From level 10, once your fleet can transverse jump, a researcher in any bar has a lead for you.
It points at Glasya-Labolas, a rogue Tri-Tachyon AI on Eochu Bres. It has been listening to something transmitting from a pocket of abyssal hyperspace far too dense to jump into, and it is fairly sure the ancient encryption on the signal is Sol.
It wants something off the Shroud first. If you have already killed a shrouded ship, it already has what it needs. If not, go into the Abyss and kill one.
You get a Macro-scale Translocator and a set of coordinates well past the northern edge of every chart you own. Sit on top of them, switch it on, and Sol arrives in the Sector.
Not in the mood? Glasya-Labolas will just place Sol for you, and LunaSettings can spawn it with the sector at game start like any other system.

The Colony Crisis: "Discovering the Past"
Every month, your Sol colonies fill a meter in the intel screen: the bigger the colonies and the more expensive their industries, the faster it rises. Nothing lowers it.
Pirates and the Luddic Path set up bases nearby and start raiding. Then one of pirates, Pathers or Remnants hits you in force, then two at once, then all three.
Survive that and the meter drops back, but every wave after it is bigger. The Remnants come out of the nests in Sol itself.
On, off, meter speed and wave strength are all in LunaSettings.

What Is In The System
A hypershunt around the Sun, a gate, a Domain-era mothership, a cryosleeper past Pluto.
Gungnir Dockyard, an abandoned station over Mars with its storage still stocked.
The Inexorable Stasis, a cryo-detention platform holding eight prisoners. Wake one and it flies for you.
Remnants in four settings: none, light (outer system only, the default), heavy, overrun. Light leaves the inner planets clear to colonize from day one.
Alpha Centauri (three stars, Proxima b, a guarded nest with three Radiant wrecks) and Beta Centauri a few light-years out.

Where This Comes From
Sol Solar System by Bugatti Echelon: the planet textures, star art, the planet descriptions, the cryo-prison and the Centauri constellation all come from there.
Solsector by Ugly American: the Remnant nest approach.
Music: "Breath of SOL" by Taiwendo, from Bugatti Echelon's mod. It plays the whole time you are in Sol or Alpha Centauri.

FAQ
Where is Sol? I can't find it.
That is the point. Do the quest, or set "When Sol appears" to "At game start" in LunaSettings.
Can I add this to an existing save?
Yes. The quest hooks itself up on load and the system is generated when you finish it.
Do I need Ashes of the Domain, Random Assortment of Things or Industrial Evolution?
No. Nothing is required except LunaLib and LazyLib. If you do have them, Sol picks up the Nidavellir ring on Mars, the Pluto Mining Station, relic conditions, ruins you can restore and seasonal meteor showers. Unknown Skies and Dreams of the Past are supported the same way. Without them you just get fewer conditions.
Is there radiation?
No.
The Remnants are too much / not enough.
Four levels in LunaSettings, from none to overrun.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1)
Text (readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1)
Icons: Gemini

License
This mod is under the CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with the code, without giving any credit to anyone.
The planet textures, star art, planet descriptions, the cryo-prison, the Centauri constellation and the music ("Breath of SOL" by Taiwendo) come from Sol Solar System by Bugatti Echelon and keep their authors' terms.

Version log
1.0.1 - fixed Sol being left half-built (no Remnants, an empty cryo prison) when it is created alongside a mod that removes the independent faction's portraits. The cryo prison inmates now get the game's default portrait instead.
1.0.0 - first stable release. No gameplay changes since 0.4.0.
0.4.0 - the crisis meter now rises every month by how big your Sol colonies are and what industries they have, instead of once for each new colony, size or industry. A Sol that stops growing no longer stalls the crisis.
0.3.7 - fixed a crash when a patrol finished building a comm relay, nav buoy or sensor array that another patrol had already built or captured.
0.3.6 - Sol and the Centauri systems are placed correctly with Wide Horizons or Wide Horizons Basic. Thanks, Taiwendo.
0.3.5 - added the official forum link to the mod metadata, version checker, and README.
0.3.4 - fixed Shroud kills not advancing the Glasya-Labolas quest after retreat. Fixed substrate detection and recovery from existing save records.
0.3.3 - the crisis panel shows a legend of everything that raises the meter instead of repeating the stage descriptions.
0.3.2 - the translocator can no longer be sold.
0.3.1 - fixed the missing "Continue" when Glasya-Labolas hands over the translocator.
0.3.0 - the "Transferring Sol" quest. Sol is no longer on the map at game start.
0.2.1 - crisis points now follow population and build cost. Resized Mercury, Venus, Jupiter and Saturn.
0.2.0 - the "Discovering the Past" colony crisis. Wider orbits.
0.1.1 - first public build: the system, the cryo-prison, Gungnir Dockyard, configurable Remnants, Alpha and Beta Centauri.

discordPostHtml:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35983.0

This is my edited version of Bugatti's Sol mod - But with many tweaks, a new questline to discover sol, less loot in your face, nerfed slightly, distances changed, planets are larger and move slower so they're not as annoying to dock to and more.

Also has a colony crisis mechanic (that you can disable) that adds tons of enemies for you to fight depending on your progression in the sol system
aiDescription: Adds the Sol star system, including eight planets, Pluto, and major moons, to the game. Players can discover Sol through a quest involving a rogue AI or spawn it at game start via settings. The system features a colony crisis mechanic where expanding colonies attract raids from pirates, Luddic Path, and Remnants. It includes unique locations like Gungnir Dockyard, a cryo-detention platform, and nearby Centauri systems.
